context.person: A person using a news application
context.user_goal: Review preferences or restore daily delivery.

product_state.preceding_state: The reader changed a daily newsletter to a weekly digest.
product_state.current_state: Daily emails stop after today's edition. The weekly digest arrives each Monday.
known_facts: Daily emails stop after today's edition.
The weekly digest arrives each Monday.
The preference can be changed again at any time.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product confirmation so the person can understand newsletter frequency change, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Only the regular newsletter frequency changed.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Review preferences or restore daily delivery.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
